sloka: नय रथमधिरोप्य वासवं नगरमितो व्रज सेनया वृतस्त्वम् ।अहमपि तव गच्छतो द्रुतं सह सचिवैरनुयामि पृष्ठतः ।। ७.२९.४१ ॥
transliteration: naya rathamadhiropya vāsavaṁ nagaramito vraja senayā vṛtastvam ।ahamapi tava gacchato drutaṁ saha sacivairanuyāmi pṛṣṭhataḥ ।। 7.29.41 ॥

translations.english: Take Vasava (Indra), place him on the chariot, and you, surrounded by the army, go from here to the city; I also, with my ministers, will quickly follow behind you as you go.
